objective: Explain the last authoritative supply pickup decision for a reported Rifle need before collection begins.
ownership: SquadExecution alone records one latest scalar diagnostic per own Rifle squad during an already-occurring decision. OpeningResupply projects it once per reported squad, only when no real collection exists. No UI decision owner.
optional_claim_unused: game/logistics/army_supply_view.gd: existing recipient-detail presentation should need no edit.
acceptance: An actual reported need before urgency can show Last supply pickup check at <simulation time>: Collection was not yet urgent for the squad, while HQ coverage stays separate.
Recorded reasons derive only from existing decision context, actual threat and final withdrawal calculations; no gate is evaluated again for the UI.
A changed current intent, parent or owner cannot expose an earlier operation reason as current; display Supply pickup has not been checked for this operation yet.
Existing collection facts take precedence; diagnostic reads return fresh scalar dictionaries and never mutate demand, stock, collection, orders or settlements.
No decision thresholds/outcomes, custody, starting stocks including HQ6000, prices, rates, polling, signals or timers change.
commands_events_timed_work: No new command, event, subscription, poll or timer. Existing SquadExecution decision writes the small record; existing visible Army panel refresh reads it.
lifecycle: Existing current intent id, actual parent and owner guard the accessor; the scene/session owns and replaces SquadExecution. At most one record per relevant squad, no history. Last-assessed time explicitly avoids claiming current eligibility between decisions.
cancellation_replacement_late: Diagnostic has no authority to start, cancel or resume collection. Current collection facts win. New operation without a matching decision is unknown; no event or late result can create work.
design_direction: Designer approved meaning and Last supply pickup check wording in direct consultation; exact-head review still required. Early local refill may use existing HQ reserve, without new rear-production credit. Full91 remains open.
verification_policy: No local engine, regression fixtures/suites, broad scenario, failure injection or coverage matrices. If needed one explicit GitHub direct new-explanation demonstration under the existing45s process bound; syntax is not gameplay acceptance.
safeguards: No repeated broad reads: reuse decision locals and bounded dictionary lookups.
Detached fresh scalar result: Dictionary values otherwise share references.
Current operation guard and session lifetime prevent stale feedback.
Retain all historical evidence and unverified ordinary-loop/FPS limits.

sources.why: Actual decision computes urgent/context/threat/withdrawal before collection.
Existing short-circuit collection context predicates, preserving order and capability call count.
Current fresh recipient projection already carries actual collection/activity and uses existing UI lifecycle.
Return a newly constructed scalar dictionary; never expose mutable owner storage.
Existing scene-owned processing/lifecycle remains; no new callback is required.

direct_check_scope: One optional explicit GitHub45s script: supplied detached inputs exercise the actual normal transport-assignment decision recording, detached diagnostic read and next-operation unknown state. No stock, need, movement, combat, scenario or failure is injected; no natural need/normal urgency/full-loop claim.
wording_consultation: Designer: Last supply pickup check at <simulation time>: <reason>. New operation: Supply pickup has not been checked for this operation yet. Reasons are past tense; existing collection facts win. UIUX: keep parent mismatch, missing rendezvous, not urgent, nearby threat and survival causes distinct.

unexecuted_input_correction.reason: Replaced proposed unavailable-destination input with normal transport-assignment input to avoid failure injection under current human policy. No engine execution occurred before this correction.
